text.text_excerpt: I like The Swamp. We sat at the bar for a while listening to a great band. Had a cocktail called The Swamp-probably would not get it again-too sweet. Then, we were entertained by some (drunk) people riding the mechanical bull. After that we went out on the balcony to catch the sights of Bourbon Street. Bathroom was fine. One of the nicer dive bars on Bourbon Street.

For a great place for cheap drinks and prime location on Bourbon, The Swamp is the place to be! Decor, prices and atmosphere are all great qualities here. You can drink and dance on the first floor, second floor, outside or even chill out on the balcony. Heck, you can ride a mechanical bull here if you really wanted to! What I love about this place is that it is very social and people come here to party and have fun. For a bar so simple, there really isn't much I have to, or care to, knock on it. This bar was a good time. It's the farthest thing from classy, but what do you expect from a bar called the swamp. We ended up coming here a couple times during our stay. They have an inside bar with a dj and dance floor. Good music to dance too. Outside they have a bar and a mechanical bull. They also have very aggressive shot girls. I did end up caving in and took two shots out of a girls mouth which she placed there. Overall we had a good time here.
